mapper.select: SELECT user_id, admin_level, dept_id, status, delegable_revision, appointed_by FROM sys_admin ORDER BY user_id FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, parent_id, status FROM sys_dept ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, role_type, status FROM sys_role ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
SELECT admin_user_id, role_id, configured_by FROM sys_admin_delegable_role ORDER BY admin_user_id, role_id FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, dept_id, status FROM sys_user WHERE id IN #{id} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_admin(user_id, admin_level, dept_id, appointed_by, status, delegable_revision) VALUES(#{userId}, #{level}, #{deptId}, #{actorId}, 1, 1)
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_admin SET admin_level=#{level}, dept_id=#{deptId}, appointed_by=#{actorId}, appointed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, status=1 WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND status=0
UPDATE sys_admin SET status=0 WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND status=1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_admin_delegable_role WHERE admin_user_id=#{userId} AND role_id=#{roleId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_admin_delegable_role(admin_user_id, role_id, configured_by) VALUES(#{userId}, #{roleId}, #{actorId})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_admin SET delegable_revision=delegable_revision+1 WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND delegable_revision=#{expected} AND delegable_revision < 2147483647
